description: This Java source file defines a final class 'QueryParser' responsible for parsing search commands into query objects within a Thing Search context. It handles different command types such as 'QueryThings' and 'StreamThings' and constructs corresponding queries using various factory classes. It also includes methods for parsing SudoCountThings commands and setting query options based on RQL strings.

classes.name: QueryParser
classes.description: A utility class for creating and parsing queries from search commands within the Thing Search service, utilizing various factories and parsing options.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method for creating an instance of QueryParser with specified criteria and field expression factories.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Converts a ThingSearchQueryCommand into a Query object, handling options and different command types.

methods.name: parseSudoCountThings
methods.description: Creates a Query for a SudoCountThings command.

methods.name: parseCriteria
methods.description: Constructs Criteria based on the command's filter and namespace restrictions.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Parses RQL options string and applies them to the query using a visitor pattern.
